case_name: Sanmet Bai vs Mu.Rasekeliya Bai And Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sanmet Bai, wife of Shri Vishwanath Rajwar
parties.respondent_defendant: Mu. Rasekeliya Bai and others (including her son Butan)

facts_of_case: The suit property was held by Dular Sai. His widow Bechni filed the instant suit for declaration of title and permanent injunction, but died during pendency. Her daughter Sanmet substituted as plaintiff. The original plaintiff claimed her son Aghan Sai was impotent and his wife left him, so he didn't marry defendant No.1 or have a child with her.

legal_principles.principle: Custom must have been observed for a long time and must be ancient.
legal_principles.held: Thus, the custom must have been observed for a long time and must be ancient.
cited_cases: Sanmet Bai vs Mu.Rasekeliya Bai And Others (2019)

legal_principles.principle: Customs will have to be always strictly proved and in relation to matrimonial matters particularly to existence of customs.
legal_principles.held: Customs will have to be always strictly proved and in relation to matrimonial matters particularly to existence of customs.
cited_cases: Gurdit Singh v. Mst. Angrez Kaur and others (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed, reversing the decree passed by the trial court and dismissing the suit of the plaintiff.
